_note: Example build profile: a placeholder so the gem panel has something to show. Make your own instead: import a Path of Building build (Settings → Build profile), or open the editor (Profiles → New profile, or Duplicate this one). This file is bundled and read-only; saving it in the editor makes a copy of your own. 'stages' = which gems are linked in which level range; socket colours are computed from data/gems.json, not written here. 'gemPlan' = where each gem comes from (drives the reward pick + shopping list).
